historicalWarnings.message: WARNING: 2 ObjectDB instances were leaked at exit (run with --verbose for details).
historicalWarnings.comparison: The same no-request fixture produced the same warning in both the 0.29 current generation and the 0.28 historical generation. Samples, final actors and publications were deep-equal as parsed values.

lowGravity.semantics: Request is made only once real native grounded support is reported. Initial gravity 1 and then gravity 20 with a fixed tick-6 request correctly returned false before a native support contact existed.

adjacentSolid.semantics: The native first collision may report only the one-way body. The existing solid body is never ignored and still supports the character. The capability does not enumerate every geometrically adjacent support with extra queries.

priorAttempts.reason: The fixture inherited the smoke driver right-arrow input and horizontal speed 240. The vertical-only assertion was invalid.
The horizontal issue persisted after merely loosening numeric tolerance. The final shared fixture sets speed 0, retaining arrow controls for the jump-precedence case. No production change.
Low gravity did not have native support at fixed request tick 6; three separate nonmotor probe sources exceeded the author manifest limit of 8 sources. No production change.
One reused source bound to three nonmotor instances and the held-key second-platform case passed. Gravity 20 still first grounded only at tick 14, so a tick-6 request correctly rejected.
Request is now triggered by actual native support, and the owned exception stays until close because the shapes have not separated.
